phase: BIONIC TACTICAL Design System Phase 1 - Frontend Testing
summary: Tested BIONIC TACTICAL Navigation and Design System Phase 1 implementation. Desktop navigation works correctly with all links and dropdown menus. Territory page loads with BIONIC layer panel. Mobile hamburger menu has positioning issue (outside viewport).

features_tested.notes: All navigation links work correctly: Home, Dashboard, Intelligence dropdown, Map dropdown, Trips, Analyze, Shop. Admin lock icon and cart button visible.
Hover reveals Analytics, Forecast, Plan Maître links with descriptions. Group-hover CSS working correctly.
Hover reveals Carte Interactive and Mon Territoire links with descriptions.
Lock icon button visible in navigation with data-testid='admin-link'
Cart button visible with data-testid='cart-button', shows badge when items in cart
Page loads with 'Mon Territoire BIONIC™' title, Leaflet map container, and Couches (Layers) panel on left side

Layer panel visible on Territory page with options: Habitats optimaux, Rut potentiel, Salines potentielles, Affûts potentiels, Trajets de chasse, Peuplements forestiers, Ensoleillement, Orientation, Hydrographie avancée, Zones d'alimentation. Toggle switches work.
Hamburger menu button exists but positioned outside viewport (x=489.59 on 390px viewport). Direct navigation to pages works.
